templates.name: Harvestly Co. — Loyalty Segmentation
templates.description: Loyalty segmentation demo: a VP of Customer Marketing investigates why a mass-blast 15% off coupon cost $4.2M in margin to generate only $1.8M in incremental revenue. Genie segments the 800K-member base into Champions / New Loyalists / Cooling Off / Win-Back; Knowledge Assistant returns the Customer Marketing Playbook's segment-specific tactics; Multi-Agent Supervisor synthesizes a per-segment campaign plan.
